tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: dbang chen tshe sgrub nyi zla'i gwa'u bzhugs:

klong gsal rdo rje'i snying po las: dbang chen tshe sgrub nyi zla'i gwa'u ni: ྈྈྈ dkyil 'khor mchod tshogs dpung ji bzhin: spros pa che chung 'byor pas dpyad: spros pa gang rung brtson pa dang: dag snang dam tshig mchog gis bsgrub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: hrī: bdag dang dkyil 'khor dbang chen he ru ka: rigs kyi tshe yi gzi mdangs sku mdog dmar: log lta'i drwa ba gcod byed gri gug dang: dug lnga ye shes tshe bcud gang ba'i thod: mthu rtsal dur khrod dpal gyis mdzes par brgyan: phung po'i gzhal yas dpa' bo yab tu snang: gsang sngags las byung yang gsang yi ge gcig: snang mtha' las 'phros lha tshogs thugs tig go: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: thugs kar dbyangs gsal mtshan pa'i nyi zla'i dbus: thabs shes gnyis med sa bon snying po hrī: shes rab chu yis sa bon cher bskyed cing: thabs kyi drod kyis smin pa'i skur 'grub ste: srung ba thabs shes yab yum nyi zla'i klong: tshe yi bar chad he ru ka yis zlog: rdzogs rim ni: a: stong pa shes rab mkha' klong las: snang ba dbang chen lhang nger bzhengs: gnyis med 'khor yug gsang sngags kyis: skye 'chi med par la bzla 'o: don dam dbu ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus: sa bon snying po thugs rig tshe: thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i mtsho: srog rtsol rlung bzhin rdo rje'i bzlas: 'byung lnga'i rten 'brel grogs byos shig: ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐: spros pa chod pa'i rnal 'byor zhig: gangs khrod 'grim pa'i cha rkyen no: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'byor pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa: tshe rabs gang yang mthar thug par: tshogs gnyis ye shes 'bras bu che: gces phyir pad+mas 'di skad smra: sa ma ya: bsod nams zhing gyur spyan drangs pa: tshig gi lam la rig pas bsam: hrī: 'chi med tshe yi dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das: gar bsgyur thugs rje'i bdag nyid rta mchog rol: srung zlog gnyis med tshe yi dpal bskyed phyir:

'khor bcas 'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren no: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrī: phung por he ru ka yi byin phob cig: snang ba mtha' yas mgon pos dpal skyed cig: gnyis med ye shes tshe yi bcud stsol cig: gsol ba'i don gyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: sa ma ya hūm̐: phyag 'tshal ba ni: sgo gsum dad pas rtag phyag 'tshal: rol pa 'gag med tshe dbang stsol: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: mchod 'bul ni: hrī: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams mchod pa che: klong yangs las byung kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: bsod nams ye shes spel phyir cir yang snang: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs tshe 'phel shog: ā+om̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shab+da rū pa shab+da ghan+dhe ra sa par+she khā hi: ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: bstod pa ni: hrī: snang mtha' 'chi med dpal las skur sprul pa'i: zhi bas gdul dka' mi bsrun drag rtsal can: 'chi med tshe yi dpal 'bar he ru ka: srung zlog tshe yi phrin las mdzad la bstod: bskul ba ni: hrī: rab khros dbang chen 'bar ba'i dus la babs: dus min 'chi ba'i gnod pa myur du zlogs: dbang chen lha tshogs thugs dam rgyud bskul te: 'chi med tshe dbang mngon du 'gyur bar mdzod: mā ra ya phaṭa: tshogs mchod ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: gzung 'dzin rab sbyangs ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: ā+om̐ āḥhūm̐: gces 'dzin bdag 'dzin gsod pa'i bam ro'i tshogs: bde gshegs ye shes mkha' 'gro srung mas bzhes: kha kha khā hi khā hi: lhag ma ni: ye shes lhag ma 'jig rten srung mas bzhes: bh+yo bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: skong ba ni: nyams pa bskang phyir 'byor tshogs mchod sprin gyis: bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang: gnas gter chos skyong rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:

bskang bya skong byed dbyer med rang grol klong: don gyi 'gyod tshangs bshags pa'i skur blta 'o: sa ma ya: lam khyer gyi dzap tu: lus kyi gzhal yas dbang chen he ru ka: tshe dang ye shes gnyis med snying po'i sngags: thabs shes yi dam mkha' 'gros 'tsho bar mdzad: snang stong ma 'gags rol pa'i skur blta 'o: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: sa ma ya: ༁ྃ: rjes su 'jug la tshe yi dbang sbyin ni: spro ba bskyed phyir dag snang mdzes par bsham: byin rlabs 'jug phyir tshul bzhin yan lag sbyar: dngos grub thob phyir dbang don klong du gzhug: dam tshig chu yis dus su bkru bar gyis: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: maṇ+ḍal gsol ba 'debs pa ni: e ma bla ma rin po che: bdag cag skal ldan rnal 'byor la: tshe yi dngos grub thob pa'i phyir: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub kyi: gdams pa rin chen bdag la stsol: zhus pas: slob dpon gyis: rdo rje snying po'i dkyil 'khor du: rta mchog rol pa'i bcud blangs nas: tshe yi gegs sel tshe sgrub cing: dpag med dkyil 'khor tshe la zhugs: zhes gnang ba sbyin te: ye shes dbab pa ni: rang dpa' bo rta mgrin du bsgoms pa'i thugs kar hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas bde chen pad+ma bkod 'og min chos kyi dbyings nas bde gshegs kyi nus pa drangs nas tshe'i ngo bor bdag la thim par bsgom: hrī: chos dbyings dgongs pa rang grol gyis: skye med chos sku'i tshe dbang stsol: 'gag med mtshan dpe'i skur snang bas: 'gag med longs sku'i tshe dbang stsol: gang 'dul mdzad pa'i phrin las skus: tshad med sprul sku'i tshe dbang stsol: zhi bas 'dul dka' drag po'i skus: rta mchog rol pa'i tshe dbang stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: de ltar ye shes dbab pa de nyid brtan par bya ba ni: su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā: bum pa thogs la: hrī: rta mchog rngams pa'i bum pa ni: 'chi med tshe yi bcud kyis gtams:

skal ldan lus dbang lha yis bskur: 'chi med tshe yi skur smin no: ā+om̐ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa: ā+om̐ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā+om̐: bhan+dha bdud rtsi gtad la: hrī: dbang chen thabs shes gsang ba'i rgyun: 'chi med tshe yi bcud kyis gtams: skal ldan ngag dbang sngags kyis bskur: 'chi med tshe yi skur smin no: rtsa sngags: bā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: shes rab ye shes dbang ni: hrī: shes rab ye shes las byung ba'i: dga' bzhi 'chi med bcud kyis gtams: skal ldan yid dbang chos kyis bskur: 'chi med tshe yi skur smin no: rtsa sngags: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dz+nyā na gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: rig pa tshig dbang gi me long gtad la: hrī: tshig gi bdud rtsi rna dbang reg byas myong: don dam tshig gis mi mtshon gang shar skyongs: skye med shar cha 'gag med rang grol skyongs: rtsol med ma yengs khor yug lam du khyer: don dam skye 'chi gnyis med sa zungs shig: me tog 'thor: dga' ston dam tshig rjes kyi bya ba spyod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sngags bdag drang srong rdo rje legs: dgongs pa'i gtad rgya 'ben la 'big: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes khe mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sgrom nas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru rin po che'i gsung 'di rol pa bde chen khang zhes don gyi pho brang du shog ser las zhal bshus pa'i yi ge'i brtson pa skal ldan pad+ma stobs chen gyis bgyis pa'o/// /
